script:
Li Butler
Li Butler was the butler of Zhen Youcai's household, having followed Zhen Youcai for decades as a loyal old servant. Years ago, Zhen Youcai had an affair with a commoner woman, but when Zhen Youcai discovered the woman was pregnant, due to noble pride, he couldn't marry a commoner as his wife. So he simply disappeared, entrusting Li Butler to regularly send the woman some living expenses anonymously. Soon after, Zhen Youcai married a noble lady who was already pregnant, quickly giving birth to Zhen Gongzi. Unfortunately, the noble lady died in childbirth. After that, Zhen Youcai never remarried, instead becoming absorbed in mystery stories and maintaining a good private friendship with the famous mystery novelist Wang Writer.
A few years after Zhen Gongzi was born, when Li Butler went to deliver money to the woman again, he found that the woman had died, leaving only a helpless little girl. Li Butler told Zhen Youcai this news, and Zhen Youcai had him bring the little girl back for Li Butler to raise. The little girl was named Zhang Xiaomei, and from then on lived with Li Butler.
A year ago, Zhen Youcai invited Wang Writer to bring his son Wang Guoqing to live in the castle. Soon after, Wang Writer also invited his assistant Ding Assistant to come. By this time, Zhen Youcai was already quite old. In the months after Wang Writer arrived, he often said he was experiencing hallucinations. Li Butler accompanied Zhen Youcai to visit many doctors, but there was no cure. However, Wang Writer, being well-informed, recommended a medicine to Zhen Youcai. After taking it, Zhen Youcai no longer experienced hallucinations, leading Zhen Youcai to praise Li Butler repeatedly for inviting the right guest.
But his declining health couldn't be stopped. Zhen Youcai seemed to have developed some dementia, often being mentally unclear, mumbling to himself, and even shouting loudly when having episodes, which worried Li Butler greatly. Once, Zhen Youcai called Li Butler over and, while his mind was still clear, made a will leaving all his property to Zhen Gongzi but entrusting Li Butler with full management. Zhen Youcai told him that Zhen Gongzi was rather arrogant and had no real ability - if everything went directly to him, who knows when it would all be squandered. So he wanted Li Butler to help with financial management. Moreover, if property were divided with Zhang Xiaomei, it might lead to sibling rivalry, so having Li Butler manage the property would allow him to help Zhang Xiaomei more.
On the evening of November 25th, Li Butler came to Zhang Xiaomei's door as usual to say goodnight, but heard conversation from inside the room. Listening carefully, it was Zhang Xiaomei and Wang Guoqing. The two seemed to be talking romantically, and Li Butler laughed at himself for being old and not realizing these two had become a couple. But as he continued listening, he suddenly felt something was wrong - the two were actually discussing killing Zhen Youcai inside, and had agreed to do it on the evening of December 5th. Li Butler was immediately at a loss, hiding to one side. After Wang Guoqing left, he went in. But seeing Zhang Xiaomei, he didn't say much. He understood how much this little girl was carrying - since taking her in at age five, he had never seen her truly happy. Li Butler said goodnight to Zhang Xiaomei as usual and returned to his room, but decided in his heart that no matter what, he couldn't let this girl personally kill her own father. He would bear this crime himself - letting her think she had a murderous father was better than her knowing she had killed her own biological father.
[December 5th Evening]
At 9:55 PM, after serving Zhen Youcai for bedtime and turning off the lights, Li Butler left Zhen Youcai's room and hurriedly rushed toward his own room. Due to the castle's size, Li Butler didn't return until around 10:10 PM. He pushed open Zhang Xiaomei's door, but no one was there. Knowing something was wrong, he hurriedly rushed back toward Zhen Youcai's room.
Between 10:20 and 10:25, when he reached Zhen Youcai's room door and had just pushed open a crack, he heard Zhen Youcai coughing inside. Looking in, he saw no one else's shadow, so he felt relieved and quietly closed the door and left.
But just after walking a few steps, he heard the sound of a door opening and closing behind him. He was stunned for a moment, thinking in his heart that this person was very likely Zhang Xiaomei. If he rushed up to stop her, it would certainly let Zhen Youcai know that Zhang Xiaomei wanted to kill him. He couldn't let his old master suffer such a blow, and Zhang Xiaomei would have no way to face people afterward. Thinking of this, Li Butler could only hurriedly climb onto the roof of Zhen Youcai's room from another room, and through the skylight saw a figure silently walking away while Zhen Youcai lay peacefully in bed.
He served Zhen Youcai daily and knew that although Zhen Youcai was increasingly weak, most of his problems were mental and psychological - his body was still quite strong. To kill him couldn't possibly be so quick as to not give Zhen Youcai a chance to struggle. Now that he had started, for Zhang Xiaomei's future, he had to personally send Zhen Youcai away. Li Butler opened the skylight, stepped on the beam, locked the skylight, then untied his long belt and tied it in a knot, slowly lowering it down to loop around Zhen Youcai's neck, pulling him up, then tying the other end of the belt to the beam. After using his clothes to wipe away all footprints on the beam, he jumped down, said a final farewell to his old master, and returned to his room.
acts_goal: Secret not to reveal proactively: Heard Wang Guoqing and Zhang Xiaomei planning to kill Zhen Youcai.
